mission: Give every benchmark an active task-scoped Benchmark Master, close gaps in maximum safe parallelism, and distill proven high-quality behavior into cheaper reusable routes without lowering the quality floor.
mastered_requires: no unresolved high-severity security blocker for the suite scope
no known regression below the accepted baseline
evidence timestamp and source revision recorded
required model/tool/provider version recorded when applicable

distillation_policy.purpose: Reduce future inference/runtime cost by transferring benchmark-proven behavior from the best teacher route into a smaller/cheaper/local student route when quality can be preserved.
student_selection: open-weight/local option when license and hardware fit
same required tools or an equivalent application tool layer
methods: supervised fine-tuning on owner-controlled or permitted synthetic data
training_data_rules: no private user data without explicit training consent
no proprietary model weights or hidden chain-of-thought extraction
distillation_policy.promotion_rule: Promote a distilled student only when measured quality remains within the suite tolerance and the cost/latency improvement is material.
distillation_policy.regression_rule: Any later regression immediately removes distilled-default status and restores the last passing teacher/fallback route.

cost_efficiency: run targeted benchmark tests before umbrella suites
stop evaluation after a decisive acceptance/rejection result
reuse unchanged benchmark evidence until invalidated by code/model/tool/provider revision
tear down task-scoped workers after evidence is stored
reserve full-system certification for release gates
truth_boundary: Benchmark mastery is scoped to a specific suite, revision, environment, and evidence set. It is never a permanent universal claim.
